description: Read the enabled permission operations (`autoSettings.permitOperations`) for the authenticated user. Returns `{ permitOperations: string[] }` — use it before mutating auto-sell or auto-buy rules to confirm the action is allowed for the wallet. Requires a wallet signature identity. Read-only and idempotent.
name: tronsave_get_user_permissions

anyOf.description: Permission rows enabled for this user; defaults to `[]` when nothing is configured.
Backend-assigned permission row id; null when not yet persisted.

id.description: Backend-assigned permission row id; null when not yet persisted.
